narration: The average American wedding costs thirty-five thousand dollars. Here's what nobody says at the engagement party — that's two hundred sixty-six thousand out of your retirement.
visual: Two interlocked wedding rings SVG springs in with amber diamond sparkle. '$35,000' fades in below with downward arrow. '$266K' number springs in large in amber — 'BY RETIREMENT' sub-label fades in.

narration: Americans spend nearly three times the global average on weddings. The rest of the world gets it done for around thirteen thousand dollars — and nobody at those parties feels shortchanged.
visual: Bar chart with two columns: US '$35,000' (taller, amber) vs Global '$13,000' (shorter, gray). '3X MORE' callout arrow fades in pointing to the gap between bars.

narration: Here's the compound math. Thirty-five thousand invested at seven percent annually. Year ten: sixty-nine thousand. Year twenty: one hundred thirty-five thousand. Year thirty: two hundred sixty-six thousand.
visual: Four animated bars growing sequentially — Year 0, Year 10, Year 20, Year 30 — with dollar labels above each bar. '$266K' label and 'AT 7% FOR 30 YEARS' text appear at end.

narration: One in five couples borrows money for their wedding — eleven thousand dollars on average. They spend the next three years paying it back while the market keeps running without them.
visual: Two person silhouettes side by side. A heavy weight bar labeled '$11,700 DEBT' hangs below them with downward arrow. Counter shows '3 YEARS OF PAYMENTS' ticking up. Red X through a growth chart beside them.

narration: That two hundred sixty-six thousand dollars could fund four years of private college, a full down payment on a starter home, or four extra years of early retirement. For one party.
visual: Three items spring in one by one: graduation cap SVG + '4 YEARS OF COLLEGE', house SVG + 'HOME DOWN PAYMENT', alarm clock SVG + '4 YEARS EARLY RETIREMENT'. '$266K =' header above all three.

narration: Have a wedding you can actually afford without debt, and invest the difference. That one choice compounds for decades. Share this before someone you know writes a thirty-five thousand dollar check.
visual: Two side-by-side paths: left path shows '$35K → party icon → $0' (declining), right path shows '$35K → investment chart → $266K' (growing). Amber CTA card at bottom: 'SHARE BEFORE THEY SIGN THE CONTRACT'.
